twin_sim.window.label: SIMULATED (window choice uses real ERA5 rain)
twin_sim.window.selection: held-out 2025 Jun-Sep: 00 UTC-aligned 7-day window with the most ERA5 rain (mean of 4 sites)
twin_sim.window.forecasts: horizon 24 h every day (P2 policy forecaster); plus 48 h on window days (day-1 + day-2 archived JMA GSM, all issued before 00 UTC); issued 00 UTC
twin_sim.window.plans: P0, P1, P2 every day, issued 00 UTC, each from its own nominal-parameter run
twin_sim.window.sensed_fill: telemetry[].fill.fill_fraction: hourly in the window, 6-hourly elsewhere; at 00 UTC = the reading the P2 dispatcher used

disclaimers: Values marked SIMULATED come from the digital twin, not from field hardware.

Rain: ERA5 reanalysis (real). Forecasts use archived real JMA GSM runs issued before each 00 UTC decision. Tide: harmonic prediction from a fit to Open-Meteo Marine model sea level 2022-11-23..2023-12-31 (model data, not a gauge).
Interceptor and telemetry: twin with nominal ASSUMPTION parameters, policy P2, monsoon 2025 (held-out year). Plans: P0, P1, P2, each from its own nominal run.
